name: Transylvania
summary: The Bran corridor is one of the few long passes for crossing over the Southern Carpathians, between Muntenia and Transylvania. Representative villages: Bran, Moeciu, Fundata, Râșnov. Țara Moților, also known as the Land of Stone, is an ethno-geographic region in Romania. Țara Oașului is a popular Romania, meaning a Romanian geographical, historical, and ethno-cultural region made up of the Oaș Depression and the mountains that border it, the Oaș Mountains and the Gutâi Mountains with their ramifications. It is located in the north of Transylvania, in the counties of Maramureș and Satu Mare.

sources.title: Țara Făgărașului
sources.excerpt: Țara Făgărașului is a depression and a historical land in Transylvania, situated along the middle course of the Olt River, with the center in the medieval fortress of Făgăraș. sources.title: Ținutul Secuiesc
sources.excerpt: Ținutul Secuiesc is – in the historical-ethnographic sense – the region in the southeastern part of Transylvania, inhabited mostly by Székelys, which includes the territories of the former Székely seats.
